n1.speaker: npc_marrow
n1.text: You went against the Rubric. That's permitted. I'll want the reason in the margin, and I'll want it to be a reason.

n2.speaker: npc_marrow
n2.text: Now you know the second rule. The file is a claim. The archive is evidence. The soul is a witness.

n3.speaker: npc_marrow
n3.text: You need two of the three to agree before you stamp.

n4.speaker: npc_marrow
n4.text: Interview them. Ask what the file can't tell you. They will lie, mostly to look better. Watch for the ones who lie to look worse.

n5.speaker: npc_marrow
n5.text: And Grist reports a soul loose at the stair in the Court. If you pass him, lend him a word.
